children: DeFi Development announced a proposed registered offering of up to $20.0 million of Variable Rate Series C Perpetual Preferred Stock (CHAD Stock) with an initial annual dividend rate of 13.00%.
Plans to offer up to $20.0 million of CHAD Stock, with a 30-day underwriter option for an extra 15% of shares.
CHAD Stock accrues cumulative dividends; initial daily annualized rate set at 13.00%, payable daily; first regular payment Oct 1, 2026.
Shares are perpetual with no stated maturity; company will fund a dividend reserve equal to 12 months of dividends ($1.30 per share).
Net proceeds intended for general corporate purposes, including working capital, acquiring SOL and other digital asset investments.
Offering registered on Form S-3 (File No. 333-295142); R.F. Lafferty & Co. is sole book-running manager; subject to market conditions.
